name: Slit Stretch
description: The first clip is a sheet cut with rows of staggered slits that is pulled from both ends: it lengthens, the slits open into diamonds and the strands between them twist and thin out like expanded metal until only the second clip is left behind. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: size
params.description: Length of a slit and its bridge, relative to the frame height

params.name: stretch
params.description: How much the sheet lengthens as it is pulled

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the shading of the twisting strands and of their shadow

params.name: neck
params.description: How much the sheet narrows at its waist as it is pulled

params.name: horizontal
params.description: Pull the sheet sideways instead, with vertical slits
